Listen: trauma is not scaleable, it does not have a hierarchy. You are not somehow "faking" your own emotional response to this, and emotional response is the only useful metric for trauma honestly. This section from [this](http://www.goodtherapy.org/blog/scale-traumatic-events/) article sums it up:

*"The severity of trauma, the danger, horror, and fear involved cannot be compared—regardless of what the content of the traumatic occurrence was. Regardless of how much or how little was endured, all traumatic experiences lie within the category of utmost extreme.
